scope: Existing ImageGen 2D raster cucumber maki and deterministic packing recipe only. No Blender dish model or fabricated 3D evidence. No candidate has been assessed.

independence.notes: Source, snapshot, fixed target, style reference and actual publisher were inspected before proposing criteria. Broad source text discovery was narrowed to relevant publisher and held-plane files; no other object critique was used.

sourceFindings: The actual source is two dark nori cylinders on a small ivory plate, with warm white rice rings and distinctly green cucumber centers. The back-left/front-right arrangement and high oblique view read clearly at 66px, 40px and 32px widths.
The source has angular rice facets, near-black nori areas and cool-gray plate shadows. It remains recognizable but has a harder, busier painted finish than the selected warm soft style.

Original snapshot RGBA is identical to the actual registered static atlas. Repacking the actual source with the actual alpha>8 crop, uniform 132-native-pixel width and center at192,496 reproduces the atlas RGBA exactly.

All four declared N/E/S/W contexts reference the same single 384x640 atlas and original full-frame rect [0,0,384,640]. There is one static nonlooping frame at12fps; directional reinterpretation would be incorrect.
targetFindings: The frozen target keeps the two-roll cucumber recipe, small ivory servingplate and readable high oblique view. It is a relevant warm soft style target with rounder rice, warmer ceramic volume, bright green cucumber faces and controlled edible highlights.
The target has dense olive nori facets at enlarged scale. Judge the resulting nori as a coherent cylinder at game size; exact replication of each facet or grain is not required.

Normalizing the target alpha>8 bounds to132native pixels gives132x106, matching the original packed cutout dimensions. This makes the target relevant to the locked scale without using its raw full canvas as registration proof.

Raw target alpha>0 bounds include extensive near-transparent pixels far beyond its visible plate. The frozen raw target must remain untouched with provenance. A single ordinary lossless alpha-bounds crop into a canonical source is permissible; do not threshold, paint, remove interior RGBA, warp or silently fit a second time.

captureContract.standaloneCropRule: One effective source crop at alpha>8, then uniform Lanczos width normalization and centered full-frame packing; no direction/pose fitting.

dependencyFindings: The standalone publisher uses alpha>8 bounds. Actual character_composition.py uses alpha>0 for a fixed held-plane UV rectangle, derives its aspect ratio from that rectangle, packs the image and anchors its lowest plate pixel to palms. The source alpha-bound convention is a real downstream dependency.

The raw original source has alpha>0 bounds[0,53,1234,1134] but alpha>8 bounds[32,163,1222,1118]. Any canonical cropped replacement needs an honest versioned source/crop/UV dependency record; the raw source cannot be silently swapped into a held plane with stale UV assumptions.

Standalone dish approval may be issued with current bubble/held runtime updates explicitly pending if exact matching-art context previews and dependency evidence are supplied. That approval must not claim a global bubble/character/Godot cutover; downstream packed captures require their corresponding object pair review rounds.
desiredOutcomesRanked: Warm, coherent rounded food/ceramic forms with readable midtones and soft controlled reflections.
Unmistakable two-roll cucumber maki identity on the small ivory plate, including dark nori, warm white rice and fresh green cucumber at small use sizes.
Clean transparent exterior and honest once-cropped source provenance, with exact fixed frame/root/scale/facing/atlas preservation.
